name: linkedin-search
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor
short: Searches LinkedIn's public job listings for any city, country or remote.
what: Searches LinkedIn's public job listings for any city, country or remote, with filters for how recent and remote, hybrid or on-site, and can pull a posting's full description. It needs no LinkedIn login. It's part of a larger AI job search framework.
who: Job seekers who are comfortable in a terminal. The skill on its own only needs Bun. The full framework (CV setup, applications, interview prep) is built on Claude Code.
needs: Bun, a JavaScript runtime. It's all the skill needs
For the full framework: Claude Code (a paid Claude plan or API credits), Python 3.10+ and LaTeX
No LinkedIn account and no API key

steps.title: Get the framework
steps.text: The README has no one-line skill install, so you get the whole repo. If you'll put your own CV in it, use a private repo rather than a public fork (the README explains how in SETUP.md section 8).
steps.code:
gh repo fork MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search --clone
cd ai-job-search

steps.title: Set up your profile (full framework only)

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text:
bun run .agents/skills/linkedin-search/cli/src/cli.ts search -q "product manager" -l "Berlin, Germany" --remote remote --format table

Or ask your agent: Are there any marketing manager jobs in London posted in the last 7 days?

watch: The skill's own docs say automated access is against LinkedIn's Terms of Service. Keep volume low and don't use it commercially or for bulk data collection.
A public fork plus /setup would put your CV and salary expectations in public. Use a private repo.
The other job board skills in the repo are Danish, so most readers will only use this one.
